messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Every time we get a new order from the sales department, first, one of my masters determines the necessary parts and quantities as well as the delivery date. Once that information is present, it has to be entered into our production planning system (PPS). It optimizes our production processes and creates possibly uniform work packages so that the setup times are minimized. Besides, it creates a list of parts to be procured. Unfortunately it is not coupled correctly to our Enterprise Resource Planning system (ERP), so the data must be transferred manually. By the way, that is the second step. Once all the data is present, we need to decide whether any parts are missing and must be procured or if this is not necessary. Once production is scheduled to start, we receive a notice from the system and an employee takes care of the implementation. Finally, the order will be checked again for its quality.

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment Process" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="New order received from sales">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- Task 1: Determine parts, quantities, and delivery date -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DetermineDetails" name="Determine necessary parts, quantities, and delivery date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Task 2: Enter data into PPS -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterDataPPS" name="Enter information into Production Planning System (PPS)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Task 3: Transfer data manually to ERP -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TransferDataERP" name="Transfer data manually to ERP system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Are parts missing? -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProcurementCheck" name="Are parts missing and need to be procured?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcureYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcureNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Task 4: Procure missing parts -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcureParts" name="Procure missing parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcureYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Merge Procurement Paths -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProcurementMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcureNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Intermediate Catch Event: Notice from PPS -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NoticeReceived" name="Receive notice to start production">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_01" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- Task 5: Implement production -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ImplementProduction" name="Implement production order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Task 6: Quality check -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_QualityCheck" name="Check order for quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- End Event -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order fulfilled successfully">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_DetermineDetails" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_DetermineDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterDataPPS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_EnterDataPPS" targetRef="Task_TransferDataERP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_TransferDataERP" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementCheck" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcureYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcurementCheck" targetRef="Task_ProcureParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcureNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcurementCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ProcureParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcurementMerge" targetRef="Event_NoticeReceived" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Event_NoticeReceived" targetRef="Task_ImplementProduction" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ImplementProduction" targetRef="Task_QualityCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_QualityCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" />
